meta.title: Session read state
meta.description:
Right-click a Session in the sidebar, or use the "More" button at the end of its row, and the Session menu gains one row: **Mark session read** or **Mark session unread**

An unread Session shows a **New** pill beside its title; marking a Session read hides its "done" prompt until you open it once.

Marks live in this browser only. Nothing is written to the session log and the model never sees them, so a mark does not follow you to another browser or device.

Latest version: [release notes](https://github.com/asjdf/dsh-session-read-state/releases)
